record.text: For anyone wondering, 60FPS does not divide cleanly (16.666... ms), HOWEVER it is self-healing: every sixty seconds it syncs back, correcting any offset that happened in the first half of the minute with equal and opposite offsets on the back half of the minute.

#GameDev Some games utilize what's called a "heartbeat" tick. Let's say, for example, that you want to run a function once each second. To do this cleanly, you fire that calc every...
- 100 frames at 100FPS (10ms = clean integer)
- 50 frames at 50FPS (20ms = clean integer)
